method: Independent read-only actual bundle/plist/resources/frameworks/embedded-code comparison, fresh codesign validation and manifest/source hash check. No install, launch, credential or permission action.
statusScope: Stage identity/content/signature and stored evidence integrity only. Actual OS prompt and intentional next Home send remain unverified.

Resources.entryCounting: All descendant directories, regular files and symlinks; broader than the stage manifest file inventory.

Frameworks.entryCounting: All descendant directories, regular files and symlinks; broader than the stage manifest file inventory.

machineCodeComparison.normalization: Read actual signed Mach-O64; exclude embedded LC_CODE_SIGNATURE payload, zero its dataoff/datasize and __LINKEDIT vmsize/filesize only. Compare remaining bytes without modifying binaries.

limits: Preserving the designated requirement does not grant OS permissions.
No actual credential recovery, Home submission or whole-release success is implied.
